name: LD1086DT33TR
title: LD1086: 1.5 A low-dropout positive regulator, adjustable or fixed 1.8 to 12 V
summary: The LD1086 is a three-terminal positive linear regulator that delivers up to 1.5 A with about 1.3 V across it at full load. It comes adjustable (1.25 V reference) or fixed at 1.8, 2.5, 3.3, 5 or 12 V, trimmed to ±1% at 25 °C, packaged in DPAK, D²PAK, D²PAK/A, TO-220 or DFN8 (4x4), and needs at least 10 µF on the output. LD1086DT33TR is the fixed 3.3 V part in DPAK on tape and reel.
key_figures: 1.3 V typ, 1.5 V max at 1.5 A
79 dB typ, 60 dB min at 120 Hz, 1.5 A

notes: In the electrical-characteristics titles, # stands for the voltage code: 18, 25, 33, 50 and 12 for the fixed 1.8, 2.5, 3.3, 5.0 and 12 V parts, nothing for the adjustable part. LD1086B# is the adjustable B version, whose reference tolerance is wider (1.231 to 1.269 V at 25 °C against 1.237 to 1.263 V).
LD1086VY and LD1086DTTRY are the automotive-grade products: adjustable only, TO-220 and DPAK, qualified to AEC-Q100 over -40 °C to 125 °C after PAT, SYL and SBL statistical tests.
DPAK and D²PAK parts ship on reels of 2500.

circuits.title: Fixed-output regulator
circuits.description: A fixed-voltage LD1086 with nothing round it but two 10 µF polarised capacitors: one from the input to ground, one from the output to ground. The GND pin goes straight to the common ground.
notes: U1's ADJ/GND pin is GND on the fixed parts.

circuits.title: Adjustable regulator
circuits.description: The adjustable LD1086 set by two resistors. R1, 120 Ω, sits across OUT and ADJ, so the reference voltage across it fixes a current that flows on down through R2 to ground; R2 then sets the output by VO = VREF × (1 + R2 / R1). A 10 µF polarised capacitor decouples the input and another the output.

parts.note: ADJ to ground; chosen for the output voltage

notes: U1's ADJ/GND pin is ADJ on the adjustable parts.

where.VREF: reference voltage between OUT and ADJ, 1.25 V typical
where.R1: resistor from OUT to ADJ (120 Ω in the application circuit)

operation.text: A three-terminal positive regulator with a 1.5 A rated output, in fixed 1.8, 2.5, 3.3, 5 and 12 V versions and an adjustable version. Its pinout matches the common adjustable three-terminal regulators.

Dropout is 1.3 V typical and 1.5 V maximum at 1.5 A, and falls as the load current falls (about 1.09 V near no load, 1.28 V at 1.5 A, at 25 °C). It also falls as the junction warms: about 1.35 V at -50 °C to 1.1 V at 150 °C at 1.5 A.

The regulator's own operating current is delivered to the load rather than to ground, unlike a PNP-pass regulator, which helps efficiency. On the fixed parts the quiescent current is 5 mA typical, 10 mA maximum. On the adjustable parts about 40 µA (120 µA maximum) leaves the ADJ pin and changes by at most 5 µA over load and line.

The adjustable versions need a minimum load current to stay in regulation: 3 mA typical, 10 mA maximum at VI = 30 V, rising with temperature from about 1.2 mA at -50 °C to 2.2 mA at 150 °C at VI = 4.25 V.
The output is trimmed on chip to ±1% at 25 °C and holds ±2% over load, line and the full temperature range.

A 10 µF output capacitor at least is required for stability. The stable region for the adjustable part runs from about 1.2 µF to 21.75 µF with ESR from about 0.54 Ω to 6.2 Ω; for the 2.85 V and 12 V versions the ESR range is about 0.9 Ω to 21 Ω over the same capacitance span.

The adjustable parts' ripple rejection is specified with a 25 µF capacitor from ADJ to ground: 88 dB typical, 60 dB minimum at 120 Hz. In the line-transient captures (1 V input step, 200 mA load, VOUT = 10 V) the output moves about +22 mV and -22 mV with no ADJ capacitor and about +6.5 mV and -6.7 mV with CADJ = 1 µF.

Output current and power dissipation are limited internally, and a thermal limit shuts the output when the die overheats. The current limit folds back with input-output difference: about 2 A available up to roughly 9 to 12 V across the part, falling to about 0.1 to 0.2 A beyond 18 V. In a held short circuit (VOUT = 2.85 V part, VIN = 10 V) the output current comes in pulses as the thermal protection acts.
On every package the tab (the exposed pad on DFN8) is connected to the output, TO-220 included.
LD1086VY (TO-220) and LD1086DTTRY (DPAK) are adjustable automotive-grade parts, qualified to AEC-Q100 for -40 °C to 125 °C, with PAT, SYL and SBL statistical screening.
